Management Plan

- Book a face-to-face clinic appointment with a GP within approximately 4–5 days for otoscopic examination to exclude impacted earwax or other ear drum/balance system pathology.
- Administrative action: clinician will message admin team to arrange clinic slot; patient advised to call support team (phone number left in notes) to confirm/arrange appointment.
- Patient education: clinician placed a tinnitus information leaflet link in the appointment notes and advised the patient to read it.
- Advice given: do not use cotton buds to clean ears (clinician advised against this).
- If symptoms worsen or problems occur before the scheduled clinic appointment, patient advised to book another appointment or contact the clinic/support team sooner.
- If otoscopy shows impacted cerumen, removal may be performed (noted as a likely simple, fixable cause); if otoscopy is normal, further assessment (e.g., audiology or ENT referral) to be considered based on findings (next steps to be determined after examination).
